mapper.sql: trip_plan_id AS planId, user_id AS userId, anchor_content_id AS anchorEventId, title, trip_date AS tripDate, visit_start_time AS visitStartTime, visit_end_time AS visitEndTime, save_yn AS saved, ai_yn AS aiGenerated, transport_md AS transportMode, headcount
mapper.select: SELECT i.trip_item_id AS itemId, i.trip_plan_id AS planId, i.seq_order AS seq, i.item_type AS type, COALESCE(i.event_content_id, i.place_content_id) AS contentId, COALESCE(e.event_name, p.place_name) AS name, CASE WHEN i.item_type = 'EVENT' THEN e.event_type ELSE '음식점' END AS category, COALESCE(e.addr, p.addr) AS address, COALESCE(e.mapy, p.mapy) AS lat, COALESCE(e.mapx, p.mapx) AS lng, COALESCE(e.image_url, p.image_url) AS imageUrl, i.start_time AS startTime, i.duration_min AS durationMin, i.time_fix_yn AS timeFixed, i.ai_reason AS aiReason, p.open_time AS openTime, p.close_time AS closeTime FROM trip_item i LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_content_id = i.event_content_id LEFT JOIN place p ON p.content_id = i.place_content_id WHERE i.trip_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY i.seq_order
SELECT interest_label FROM trip_plan_interest WHERE trip_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY interest_label

SELECT content_id AS contentId, open_time AS openTime, close_time AS closeTime FROM place WHERE display_yn = 1 AND content_type_cd = 39 AND ABS(mapy - #{lat}) <= 0.015 AND ABS(mapx - #{lng}) <= 0.02 AND (open_time IS NULL OR close_time IS NULL OR (open_time <= #{mealStart} AND close_time >= #{mealEnd})) ORDER BY POW((mapy - #{lat}) * 111000, 2) + POW((mapx - #{lng}) * 88000, 2), content_id LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trip_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND save_yn = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_plan (user_id, anchor_content_id, title, trip_date, visit_start_time, visit_end_time, save_yn, ai_yn, transport_md, headcount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{anchorEventId}, #{title}, #{tripDate}, #{visitStartTime}, #{visitEndTime}, 0, 0, #{transportMode}, #{headcount})

INSERT INTO trip_item (trip_plan_id, seq_order, item_type, event_content_id, place_content_id, start_time, duration_min, ai_reason, time_fix_yn) VALUES (#{planId}, #{seq}, #{type}, #{contentId}NULL, #{contentId}NULL, #{startTime}, #{durationMin}, #{aiReason}, #{timeFixed})
